```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
# ============================================================
# ORA for all nonsilently mutated cancer genes
# Purpose: cancer-gene-list (by OncoKB) pathway enrichment among all mutated genes
# just to check, it is biologically biased by design because the query genes are already selected from a cancer gene list.
# Query/input:
#   All nonsilently mutated cancer genes in the cohort
#   from Tier1_common_cancerGeneList_mutation_frequency_all_genes.tsv
#
# Background/universe:
#   All nonsilently mutated genes in the full cohort MAF
#
# Outputs:
#   1. Reactome ORA table + bubble plot
#   2. MSigDB Hallmark ORA table + bubble plot
#   3. GO Biological Process ORA table + bubble plot
#   4. Combined top pathway table for PPT
# ============================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(clusterProfiler)
  library(org.Hs.eg.db)
  library(ReactomePA)
  library(enrichplot)
  library(msigdbr)
  library(ggplot2)
})
```

```{r}
# -------------------------------
# Input files
# -------------------------------

query_file <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/WES/Downstream/PCGR/Compare_TumorOnly_vs_WithPON/maftools/Tier_1_common/plots/Oncovar_gene/Tier1_common_cancerGeneList_mutation_frequency_all_genes.tsv"

maf_file <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/WES/Downstream/PCGR/Compare_TumorOnly_vs_WithPON/maftools/Tier_1_common/Combined_MAF/Tier_1_common_all_samples.combined.maf"

# -------------------------------
# Output directory
# -------------------------------

out_dir <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/WES/Downstream/PCGR/Compare_TumorOnly_vs_WithPON/maftools/Tier_1_common/plots/Oncovar_gene/ORA_all_mutated_cancer_genes_vs_all_nonsilent_genes"

dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# -------------------------------
# Read query genes
# -------------------------------
# Query = all nonsilently mutated cancer genes in the cohort

query_dt <- fread(query_file)

if (!"Hugo_Symbol" %in% colnames(query_dt)) {
  stop("Hugo_Symbol column not found in query file.")
}

query_genes <- unique(toupper(trimws(query_dt$Hugo_Symbol)))
query_genes <- query_genes[!is.na(query_genes) & query_genes != ""]

message("Query genes: all nonsilently mutated cancer genes")
message("Number of query genes: ", length(query_genes))

# -------------------------------
# Read MAF and define background
# -------------------------------
# Background = all nonsilently mutated genes in the full MAF

maf_dt <- fread(maf_file, sep = "\t", header = TRUE, data.table = TRUE)

required_cols <- c(
  "Hugo_Symbol",
  "Variant_Classification"
)

missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, colnames(maf_dt))

if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing required columns in MAF: ",
    paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

maf_dt[, Hugo_Symbol_clean := toupper(trimws(Hugo_Symbol))]

# Nonsilent variant classes based on your MAF
nonsilent_classes <- c(
  "Missense_Mutation",
  "Nonsense_Mutation",
  "Nonstop_Mutation",
  "Frame_Shift_Del",
  "Frame_Shift_Ins",
  "In_Frame_Del",
  "In_Frame_Ins",
  "Splice_Site",
  "Splice_Region",
  "Translation_Start_Site"
)

background_genes <- unique(
  maf_dt[
    Variant_Classification %in% nonsilent_classes,
    Hugo_Symbol_clean
  ]
)

background_genes <- background_genes[
  !is.na(background_genes) & background_genes != ""
]

message("Background genes: all nonsilently mutated genes in full MAF")
message("Number of background genes: ", length(background_genes))

```
```{r}
# -------------------------------
# Convert SYMBOL to ENTREZ ID
# -------------------------------

query_map <- bitr(
  query_genes,
  fromType = "SYMBOL",
  toType = "ENTREZID",
  OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db
)

bg_map <- bitr(
  background_genes,
  fromType = "SYMBOL",
  toType = "ENTREZID",
  OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db
)

query_entrez <- unique(query_map$ENTREZID)
bg_entrez <- unique(bg_map$ENTREZID)

message("Query genes mapped to Entrez: ", length(query_entrez))
message("Background genes mapped to Entrez: ", length(bg_entrez))

if (length(query_entrez) < 5) {
  stop("Too few query genes mapped to Entrez IDs.")
}
```
```{r}
# -------------------------------
# Helper function
# -------------------------------

save_ora_result <- function(
  enrich_obj,
  out_prefix,
  title_text,
  table_file,
  show_n = 20
) {
  
  enrich_dt <- as.data.table(enrich_obj)
  
  fwrite(
    enrich_dt,
    file.path(out_dir, table_file),
    sep = "\t",
    quote = FALSE,
    na = ""
  )
  
  message(out_prefix, " significant terms: ", nrow(enrich_dt))
  
  if (nrow(enrich_dt) == 0) {
    message("No significant terms found for ", out_prefix, ". Plot skipped.")
    return(invisible(enrich_dt))
  }
  
  pdf_file <- file.path(
    out_dir,
    paste0(out_prefix, "_bubbleplot.pdf")
  )
  
  png_file <- file.path(
    out_dir,
    paste0(out_prefix, "_bubbleplot.png")
  )
  
  p <- dotplot(
    enrich_obj,
    showCategory = show_n,
    title = title_text
  ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9)
    ) +
    labs(
      subtitle = paste0(
        "Background: all nonsilently mutated genes in full MAF, n = ",
        length(background_genes)
      )
    )
  
  ggsave(
    filename = pdf_file,
    plot = p,
    width = 10,
    height = 8
  )
  
  ggsave(
    filename = png_file,
    plot = p,
    width = 10,
    height = 8,
    dpi = 300
  )
  
  message("Saved bubble plot:")
  message(pdf_file)
  message(png_file)
  
  invisible(enrich_dt)
}
```
```{r}
# ============================================================
# Reactome pathway ORA
# ============================================================

reactome_ora <- enrichPathway(
  gene = query_entrez,
  universe = bg_entrez,
  organism = "human",
  pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  qvalueCutoff = 0.25,
  readable = TRUE
)

reactome_dt <- save_ora_result(
  enrich_obj = reactome_ora,
  out_prefix = "Reactome_ORA_all_mutated_cancer_genes_vs_all_nonsilent_genes",
  title_text = "Reactome enrichment: mutated cancer genes vs all nonsilent genes",
  table_file = "Reactome_ORA_all_mutated_cancer_genes_vs_all_nonsilent_genes.tsv",
  show_n = 20
)
```


```{r}
# ============================================================
# MSigDB Hallmark ORA
# ============================================================

# msigdbr changed argument names across versions.
# This block supports both older and newer versions.

msigdbr_args <- names(formals(msigdbr::msigdbr))

if ("collection" %in% msigdbr_args) {
  hallmark <- msigdbr::msigdbr(
    species = "Homo sapiens",
    collection = "H"
  )
} else {
  hallmark <- msigdbr::msigdbr(
    species = "Homo sapiens",
    category = "H"
  )
}

hallmark_term2gene <- as.data.table(
  hallmark[, c("gs_name", "gene_symbol")]
)

hallmark_term2gene[, gene_symbol := toupper(trimws(gene_symbol))]

hallmark_ora <- enricher(
  gene = query_genes,
  universe = background_genes,
  TERM2GENE = hallmark_term2gene,
  pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  qvalueCutoff = 0.25
)

hallmark_dt <- save_ora_result(
  enrich_obj = hallmark_ora,
  out_prefix = "MSigDB_Hallmark_ORA_all_mutated_cancer_genes_vs_all_nonsilent_genes",
  title_text = "MSigDB Hallmark enrichment: mutated cancer genes vs all nonsilent genes",
  table_file = "MSigDB_Hallmark_ORA_all_mutated_cancer_genes_vs_all_nonsilent_genes.tsv",
  show_n = 20
)
```

  OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db,
  keyType = "ENTREZID",
  ont = "BP",
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
  qvalueCutoff = 0.25,
  readable = TRUE
)

go_bp_dt <- save_ora_result(
